data.exact_reserve_text: Change in claims incurred during the year includes positive development on prior accident years of $63.2m (2021 - $6.1m). The positive development on prior accident years is primarily from releases on 2017-2020 Weather Related Large Loss Events in Property classes, as well as recognition of favorable attritional experience in certain Property and Casualty classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Releases on 2017-2020 weather related large loss events led to positive prior-accident-year development (releases) reducing reserves.

named_events.loss_description: 2022 results were impacted by various large Weather Related Large Loss Events during the year, most significantly from Hurricane Ian.
2021 results had significant impact from Weather Related Large Loss Events, primarily Hurricane Ida.
2021 results had significant impact from Winter Storm Uri.
2021 results included impact from PCS 2176 Wind and Thunderstorm.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1458 reported opening gross claims outstanding of $1,915.5m at 1 January 2022. During 2022 the Syndicate recorded positive prior-accident-year development (a release) of $63.2m, primarily reflecting releases on 2017-2020 weather-related large loss events and favourable attritional experience in Property and Casualty lines. The 2022 year was, however, materially impacted by current-year weather related large loss events (notably Hurricane Ian) that affected current year reserving and claims.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount was taken from the narrative in the claims note: 'positive development on prior accident years of $63.2m'. The report does not supply a single explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross aggregate figure in a separate line; the $63.2m is stated as positive development in the 'Change in claims incurred' narrative. The claims development triangle is present (gross), but the PDF text extraction is fragmented and a full programmatic diagonal calculation could not be robustly completed here; therefore the narrative figure is used. All monetary figures are the report's native USD and are reported in millions.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the notes (claims development triangle). Due to fragmentary text extraction of the multi-row triangle in the PDF, the individual development period rows have not been fully reconstructed here. Use the narrative prior-year development figure cited above; detailed diagonal calculations from the triangle were not performed because the extracted rows were inconsistently aligned in the source text.
